package.name: i2rt_moveit_config
package.description: MoveIt 2 configuration for the YAM-family arms (yam_crank_4310, big_yam_linear_4310). Hand-authored rather than generated by the MoveIt Setup Assistant — good enough for IK/URDF/motion-planning checks in sim (mock_components/GenericSystem, no CAN hardware needed); the self-collision matrix here is based on kinematic adjacency, not the Setup Assistant's sampled self-collision check, so re-run the Setup Assistant against this package later if you want that refined.
